title: AgriChrono: A Longitudinal Dataset and Benchmark for Novel-View Synthesis of Field-Grown Crops
abstract: arXiv:2508.18694v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Reliable 3D reconstruction of field-grown crops is hindered by thin, overlapping structures, wind-driven foliage motion, and changing illumination. Yet longitudinal field datasets and standardized novel-view synthesis (NVS) benchmarks remain scarce. We present an integrated framework for robotic acquisition, dataset construction, NVS evaluation, and agricultural scene reconstruction. AgriChrobot enables web-based teleoperation and repeated multi-view capture along crop rows. Using this platform, we introduce AgriChrono, a longitudinal canola dataset collected over approximately one month, comprising 160 recording sessions, four RGB streams, two depth maps, and estimated camera poses. We define seven NVS scenarios spanning four times of day and three acquisition dates, and benchmark 15 NeRF- and Gaussian Splatting-based methods. translated_title: AgriChrono：面向田间生长作物新视角合成的纵向数据集与基准
translated_abstract: 田间生长作物的可靠三维重建一直受到细小且相互重叠的结构、风吹导致的叶片运动以及不断变化的光照条件的阻碍。然而，纵向田间数据集和标准化的新视角合成（NVS）基准至今仍然稀缺。我们提出了一个集成框架，涵盖机器人采集、数据集构建、NVS评估以及农业场景重建。AgriChrobot支持基于网页的远程操作，并可沿作物行进行重复的多视角采集。利用该平台，我们推出了AgriChrono——一个历时约一个月采集的油菜纵向数据集，包含160次录制会话、四路RGB视频流、两路深度图以及估计的相机位姿。我们定义了七个NVS场景，涵盖一天中的四个时间段和三个采集日期，并对15种基于NeRF和高斯泼溅（Gaussian Splatting）的方法进行了基准测试。除整幅图像指标外，我们还在人工标注的区域内对精细细节的重建效果进行评估。
tldr: 该论文提出了机器人采集平台AgriChrobot和历时约一个月构建的田间油菜纵向数据集AgriChrono，并定义了七个涵盖不同时间与光照条件的新视角合成基准场景，系统评估了15种NeRF和高斯泼溅方法在动态农田场景下的重建性能。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces AgriChrobot, a robotic multi-view capture platform, and AgriChrono, a longitudinal canola field dataset collected over one month, defining seven novel-view synthesis benchmark scenarios that systematically evaluate 15 NeRF and Gaussian Splatting methods under dynamic agricultural conditions.
